Author: Meowmeowmeow Cat
Name: Skyrim Compass
Description: Fixes Moodles and Loci compatibility. Also adds an Skyrim-style compass bar at the top of your screen (which you can disable). Shows cardinal directions, nearby entity markers, and several combat hud replacements. Commands: /compass, /compass config, /compass off (or on), /compass setup
Punchline: I got Moodles + Loci playing (somewhat) nice. Oh and theres a compass, too.
